mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN (SELECT bill_id,sum(rcpt_amt) amount FROM tb_bl_rcpt WHERE cncl_yn='N' GROUP BY bill_id) r ON r.bill_id=b.bill_id
mapper.select: SELECT b.bill_id AS "id",b.proj_id AS "projectId",p.proj_nm AS "projectName",COALESCE(c.clnt_nm,'–') AS "customerName", p.ctrt_type_cd AS "contractType",b.bill_ord::int AS "order", substring(b.bill_ym,1,4)||'-'||substring(b.bill_ym,5,2) AS "billingMonth",b.bill_dt::text AS "billingDate", b.sply_amt::text AS "supplyAmount",b.vat_rt::text AS "vatRate",b.vat_amt::text AS "vatAmount",b.tot_amt::text AS "totalAmount", (CASE WHEN b.cncl_yn='Y' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(r.amount,0) END)::text AS "receiptAmount", (CASE WHEN b.cncl_yn='Y' THEN 0 ELSE b.tot_amt-COALESCE(r.amount,0) END)::text AS "unpaidAmount", b.pay_due_dt::text AS "dueDate",b.tax_invc_no AS "taxInvoiceNo",b.cncl_yn='Y' AS "cancelled", b.cncl_rsn AS "cancelReason",b.cncl_user_id AS "cancelUserId",b.cncl_dttm::text AS "cancelledAt", p.proj_stat_cd AS "projectStatus",p.ctrt_end_dt::text AS "contractEnd", NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_bl_bill n WHERE n.proj_id=b.proj_id AND n.cncl_yn='N' AND (n.bill_ym,n.bill_id) > (b.bill_ym,b.bill_id)) AS "latest" FROM tb_bl_bill b JOIN tb_pj_proj p ON p.proj_id=b.proj_id LEFT JOIN tb_bs_clnt c ON c.clnt_id=p.cust_clnt_id WHERE b.bill_id=#{id}
mapper.update: LOCK TABLE tb_cl_close IN SHARE MODE
